method: composite (no AI re-rendering); original photo pixels kept everywhere except the masked glass area
mask: GrabCut seeded by hand-traced polygons for windscreen and driver side window; A-pillar, steering-wheel rim, rear-view mirror and door mirror (incl. stick-on blind-spot mirror) protected; small forced/colour-rule regions next to the door mirror.
fill: smooth neutral light-grey studio gradient (tones [200, 224, 226, 214], horizon at source y=330), slight per-window glass tint, faint low-frequency reflection (6% of the original glass luminance variation), light grain
watermark: Galaxy S24+ / time text removed by OpenCV Telea inpaint limited to the text pixels in the bottom-left corner (mostly outside the crop)
